_comment: THE PARAMETERS THAT DEFINE WHAT A BET IS, AND WHICH ROWS COUNT AT ALL. Hashing a number records a CHOICE; it does not make that choice LEGITIMATE. Every parameter declares its ORIGIN. Any parameter with origin='placeholder' makes the WHOLE RUN research_only: it may establish a baseline and reveal where information is missing, but it MAY NOT claim the +0.10 capture bar and MAY NOT authorize betting. This is rule 2 applied to the EVALUATOR -- we were strict about hand-picked numbers inside the model while the numbers deciding WHICH ROWS ARE BETS went unquestioned for the entire project.
_v3_correction_1: v1/v2 conflated a conditional DraftKings Early Exit promotion with the base MLB pregame settlement rule. The published base rule is: a pregame hitter selection must start and record at least one plate appearance; a substitute selection is void. The PA>=2 / under-exempt language belongs to a separate conditional Early Exit program and cannot be inferred from a final box score alone. The runner currently applies neither rule; it only uses SmartStake `result IS NOT NULL` as a settlement-presence proxy. That proxy remains a PLACEHOLDER until it is audited against a game-keyed official starter/PA bridge. No historical result may claim the base rule, much less the conditional promotion, until its inputs and scope are verified.
_v2_correction_2: v1 justified entry_hours and book with PROSE asserting a measurement ('MEASURED and recorded: CLV rises T-1h +0.0003 -> T-6h +0.0024'). *** PROSE ASSERTING A MEASUREMENT IS NOT A MEASUREMENT. *** A structural claim must point at a CHECKABLE, HASHED ARTIFACT, or it is a claim wearing a badge. Both now carry evidence_artifact: null, and both are marked UNVERIFIED until those artifacts exist.

min_edge.what_it_does: A selection is a BET iff |p_model - p_entry_devig| >= this. It DEFINES THE DENOMINATOR of the capture ratio, which is computed ON BETS ONLY.
min_edge.why_placeholder: Inherited from run_pa_market_ab.py. Never fitted, never derived from a staking rule, never validated. A different threshold selects a DIFFERENT SUBSET and yields a DIFFERENT capture ratio -- so the headline is a statistic about an arbitrary subset until this is justified.
min_edge.what_would_justify_it: A fitted threshold from a staking model, or a predeclared structural rule (e.g. the minimum edge at which this book's measured overround is cleared).

max_quote_age.what_it_does: Discards an entry quote whose last update predates the T-Nh horizon by more than this -- a STALE price nobody could actually have taken.
max_quote_age.why_placeholder: Inherited. Never measured against the actual quote-age distribution. If that distribution is bimodal, 90 could be cutting straight through a mode.
max_quote_age.what_would_justify_it: Measure the quote-age distribution; place the boundary at a MEASURED gap, or defend a structural rule about book refresh cadence.

min_bets_for_capture.what_it_does: Below this many bets, capture reports n/a rather than a number. Stops a ratio computed on a handful of rows being read as evidence.
min_bets_for_capture.why_placeholder: A round number. The PRINCIPLE is sound and non-negotiable (a capture ratio on 3 bets is a lie); the SPECIFIC VALUE is arbitrary.
min_bets_for_capture.what_would_justify_it: A power calculation: the n at which the block-bootstrap CI on capture narrows below the effect size we care about.

settlement_presence_rule.value: SmartStake `result IS NOT NULL`, selection-level (bool_or over snapshots)
settlement_presence_rule.what_it_does: Excludes selections with no vendor settlement presence. This is the ONLY use of the vendor's `result` column anywhere in the runner -- its VALUE never enters the score.
settlement_presence_rule.why_placeholder: *** IT IS NOT PROVEN EQUIVALENT TO DRAFTKINGS' ACTUAL VOID/GRADING RULES. *** DraftKings' published BASE MLB pregame rule requires a hitter to start and record at least one plate appearance; a substitute is void. The PA>=2 / under-exempt language previously written here belongs to a separate conditional Early Exit program, not the base rule, and cannot be inferred from a box score without product/event eligibility evidence. The runner implements none of this: no official starter/PA bridge, only vendor result-null. A selection DK would void is not the same thing as a selection the vendor did not grade, and the two have never been compared.
settlement_presence_rule.why_it_matters: Already MEASURED to be material: regrading hits 0.5 from all-rows to DK-gradeable moved the apparent bias from +0.1146 to +0.0687. *** ~40% OF IT WAS A GRADING ARTIFACT. *** If this proxy disagrees with DK's real rule, that correction is being re-approximated by a different rule with unknown agreement.
settlement_presence_rule.what_would_justify_it: Build a separate game-keyed official starter/PA bridge containing EVERY box-score hitter (not the starter-only model-training table). Compare vendor-null against DraftKings' published BASE rule, side-aware but without inventing an under exemption. Conditional Early Exit treatment remains unverified unless the historical product/event eligibility data exists.

base_pregame_hitter_eligibility_rule.what_it_does: Defines the documented BASE DraftKings pregame hitter eligibility rule used by the separate base-rule research artifact. A player who did not start, or who started but recorded zero PA, is void under the published base rule.
base_pregame_hitter_eligibility_rule.why_unverified: The current published rule was checked from DraftKings' official help and baseball-rules pages, but this project does not possess historical DraftKings settlement logs or product-level eligibility flags for June 2026. It must therefore remain research-only. Conditional Early Exit protection is deliberately NOT encoded: final PA alone cannot prove its injury/product/event prerequisites.
base_pregame_hitter_eligibility_rule.evidence_needed: A side/product-level historical settlement log or an independently archived rule/version that establishes the base rule and any Early Exit applicability for the evaluated June 2026 products.

entry_hours.what_it_does: The entry horizon. Edge is measured against the price available at T-4h; CLV against the close.
entry_hours.why_structural: A deliberate modelling decision about WHEN a bet would be placed, not an unexamined default. It is claimed to rest on a measured finding: that CLV rises with lead time (T-1h +0.0003 -> T-6h +0.0024).
entry_hours.why_unverified: *** THAT CLAIM IS PROSE, NOT AN ARTIFACT. *** It lives in a handoff document, not in a hashed, re-runnable output. Until it points at something checkable, origin='predeclared_structural' is doing work it has not earned. This alone does not force research-only -- but it is NOT yet a justified structural choice.
entry_hours.evidence_needed: The CLV-by-lead-time table as a hashed artifact, regenerable from the market data.

book.what_it_does: *** THE PRICE VENUE, AND ONLY THAT. *** DK supplies the entry price and the close. It does NOT, in this runner, supply a void/grading regime -- that is settlement_presence_rule, a SEPARATE and UNVERIFIED proxy. Do not conflate them.
book.why_structural: A real modelling decision: prices, liquidity and overround differ by book, and the entire capture measurement is against THIS book's line.
book.why_unverified: Also prose. And note the project has already been wrong about venues once, from general knowledge: 'exchanges run near-zero vig' was asserted and then MEASURED -- prophetx came back at 0.0777, the WORST of any venue (rule 9).
book.evidence_needed: A per-book overround / closing-sharpness table as a hashed artifact, to justify DK over Pinnacle or an exchange.

verdict_reason: FOUR parameters carry origin='placeholder': min_edge, max_quote_age, min_bets_for_capture, and settlement_presence_rule. TWO MORE (entry_hours, book) claim structural status on PROSE rather than a checkable artifact. The run may establish a trustworthy BASELINE and reveal where information is missing. It MAY NOT claim the +0.10 capture bar and MAY NOT authorize betting. This is not a formality: capture is computed ON BETS ONLY; min_edge decides which rows ARE bets; settlement_presence_rule decides which rows are SCOREABLE AT ALL. An unjustified pair of those makes the headline a statistic about an ARBITRARY SUBSET of an UNVERIFIED UNIVERSE.
path_out_of_research_only: settlement_presence_rule -- vendor-null was falsified as a DK base-rule proxy (June broad audit: 815 false inclusions among 5,800 role-resolved hard-mapped two-sided selections). Do not use it to define a DK-scored universe.

base_pregame_hitter_eligibility_rule -- maintain the official starter/PA bridge and keep the base-rule artifact research-only until historical product/rule applicability is independently established. Do not infer conditional Early Exit eligibility from PA alone.
entry_hours / book -- regenerate the CLV-by-lead-time and per-book sharpness tables as HASHED artifacts. They may well confirm the current choices; a confirmation you cannot re-run is not evidence.
min_edge -- derive from a staking rule, or declare a structural threshold tied to the measured overround.
max_quote_age -- measure the quote-age distribution; place the boundary at a measured gap.
min_bets_for_capture -- power calculation against the block-bootstrap CI width.
